A '''base''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Refnar]] was used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces discovered the base, prompting an [[Last Stand at Refnar|evacuation]] of the base.
